claims.text: Multiverse Computing team-blog exposition Sep 29 (day-only) of ProvenanceGuard: source-aware MCP verification (claim→source routing, NLI support, attribution check, allow/block, RARR repair). Blog is the W40 event; paper arXiv 2606.18037 (v1 Jun 16 / v2 Jul 26; both pre-window) is background; blog is NOT an independent result.
claims.context: HF team blog Sep 29, full body read (r2) — unchanged baseline.

claims.text: Method (v2-pinned): trace ei=(tooli,sourcei,texti); centroid routing ŝ=argmax cos (1,500-char premise cap, 512-token NLI budget, historical 256 labeled); DeBERTa-v3 NLI + attention proxy (τ=0.35, ratio 0.70) + protected-value strict check + lexical rescue (0.55/0.85); RF calibrator (400 trees/d5/leaf8/weights/Gini/seed 20260607, threshold 0.65 on val F1 0.841); attribution family matching + fail-closed aggregation; RARR repair loop. [v2 2026-07-26T10:47:53Z; v1 2026-06-16T15:10:29Z (only versions displayed)]
claims.context: Version-pinned primary v2 read 2026-10-10 (https://arxiv.org/html/2606.18037v2; header v2 26 Jul 2026; FOUR authors Alvarez/Rajan/Mugel/Orús; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) matched field-by-field against the r5 ar5iv excerpt (comparison record in r7 run): equations, Tables 1–11, 281-trace corpus, adjudication path, results, ablations all MATCH v2. Official abs history currently displays only v1/v2; revisions beyond v2 uncompared.

claims.text: 281 frozen medical traces (synthetic/de-id, no PHI); 266-trace/2,325-label subset; 40-trace 361-claim held-out (LLM-assisted 2-judge + priority; human-expert ONLY on 361): block F1 0.802 (P 0.673/R 0.993, CI [0.664,0.900]), source acc 0.858/260, src+rel 0.681. Multi-source: 59Q/254 cases/2,587 rows/263 frozen claims; block F1 0.846, source 0.503, src+rel 0.229 (wrong-chart 0.127, count 0.179 slices). Baselines support-only: MiniCheck 0.783/RAGAS 0.758/AlignScore 0.662/SummaC 0.436. Repair 173→all (144 fallback); rerun 59→59 (2 fallback); 50/50 swaps detected. Scope bound: attribution factuality ONLY (no clinical-safety/parametric claims).
